##: The zip is built from github.com/Anfioo/cursor-byok. Pushing a scoop-v<version> tag runs that repo's scoop-package workflow, which publishes the zip as a release asset and prints the version / url / hash to paste here. The file: URL below is the locally built zip; aria2 cannot download it, so install locally with aria2 disabled.
description: cursor-byok: routes Cursor's requests to your own model channels, with a built-in web console.
notes: Settings and the SQLite database live in $persist_dir and survive scoop update.
Start it from WingHarness (Settings > Plugins) or run start.cmd in the install folder.
The first start writes .env with a random CURSOR_EXTERNAL_API_KEY.
